items.description: Bootlegger Thatchfield is a branch of the Bootlegger coffee chain, based at Thatchfield Retail Centre on Brakfontein Road in Thatchfield, Centurion. The shop makes specialty grade coffee, which the business says it produces consistently and sustainably. The menu is built around all-day breakfast, lunch and brunch, served seven days a week from 7am. Free WiFi and a kids menu are available, and takeaway options are offered at all Bootlegger stores. The business describes the shop as a place where people can connect and communities can grow. The website lists the shop's address as Shop 17, Thatchfield Retail Centre, with operating times of 7am to 6pm on most days and 7am to 5pm on Sundays.

Bourbon Eyewear is a South African brand that makes polarised sunglasses, and it says its aim is dependable performance, quality, comfort and style at an honest price. Every pair offers UV400 protection, with 100% UVA and UVB coverage. The brand says its lenses give enhanced clarity so vision stays clear in every light. The frames are described as lightweight and durable, built for all-day wear on active days. The range is organised into collections, including fishing, golf, cycling, hunting, trail and photochromic styles, along with active, fashion, functional and polarised favourites. The brand says its polarised eyewear is designed for running, hiking, fishing and other outdoor activities.

Brandjam is a digital marketing agency in South Africa, and its website says it has more than 16 years of experience. The agency's view is that every client is different, so every design should be too. Its services include WhatsApp marketing, AI SEO, social media marketing and management, copywriting, graphic design and website design. Its WhatsApp lead generation package sets up WhatsApp Business, runs Meta ads, adds automated replies and designs the ads, with the aim of turning advertising into enquiries sent straight to a business's WhatsApp. For social media, the agency focuses on educational, useful and visually vibrant posts that speak to existing, returning and new customers. Brandjam describes its work as combining informative copywriting with innovative design to build a client's online presence.

Breytenbach Embroidery does embroidery on a wide range of soft garments, from almost any fabric that fits under the needle. The business embroiders corporate wear, shirts, T-shirts, golf shirts, overalls, caps, ties, jackets, jerseys and beanies, and it also works on gifts such as towels. Digitising, the step that prepares a design for stitching, is part of the service. Its customers include sports clubs, clothing factories, schools and uniform suppliers. The shop at 987 Pierneef Street in Villieria offers onsite services as well as online appointments, and its listing notes a wheelchair-accessible entrance and parking. The business describes its work as fast, high-quality and detail-driven, with attentive guidance for each customer.

Browns is a jeweller with a boutique at Menlyn Park Shopping Centre, in shop G76 on the ground floor. The brand says it has been trading since 1934, when the first piece it made was for the founder's wife-to-be. Browns says it sells only natural diamonds, which it describes as ethical and traceable, and that its pieces are expertly crafted in solid gold and platinum. Each piece carries the company's Maker's Mark, and the brand says its designs are unique and registered. The range includes engagement rings, women's and men's wedding bands, earrings, necklaces and bracelets, and custom-made pieces are made in the company's own workshop. The brand offers 100% back on any trade-in and a buy-back after five years. The Menlyn Park boutique is open Monday to Saturday from 9am to 6:30pm and on Sundays from 9am to 5:30pm.

Business Expert SA helps companies turn their data into clear business decisions. Its services include business intelligence dashboards that centralise KPIs, operational data and growth figures, along with automated reporting, KPI tracking and strategic analytics. The business says it works with business owners, teams and decision-makers, and that its focus is making reporting clearer, operations smarter and growth easier to manage. Its approach combines business understanding with data structure, automation and visual intelligence, so clients can see what matters, respond faster and plan with confidence. Solutions are described as custom for each business, with reporting designed to drive outcomes. The website also lists 24/7 insight availability and presents its dashboards as secure and built for business confidence.

Car Care Workshop Lynnwood is an automotive workshop that says it has five years of service behind it. Its work covers routine maintenance, such as oil changes, tyre rotations, fluid checks and filter replacements, along with mechanical repairs for complex faults and vehicle upgrades. The workshop says its facility uses diagnostic tools to find potential problems before they become major ones. Its technicians are described as highly skilled, and the business says the team has many years of collective experience in the automotive field. Customers can book online through the website. The business says its focus is customer satisfaction and continued growth in expertise, with the aim of keeping each vehicle running smoothly and reliably.

Casewise SA is an erwin reseller for Africa and has been a value-added reseller in South Africa since 2001. The company is an erwin Diamond Partner, a status the website says it has held since 2001. Its solutions help organisations visualise, understand, analyse and audit business strategy, complex operating processes, information flows, application deployment and IT infrastructure. Its services include enterprise architecture and business process management, along with business process analysis, information management, and governance, risk and compliance. The website says the company supports many of the world's leading organisations across a wide range of vertical markets. It describes its aim as helping businesses stay competitive when processes, teams and technology create complexity and friction.

Castle Walk Flowers, which its website calls Castlewalk Flower Market, sells hand-crafted flower arrangements, bouquets and flower baskets. Customers can choose their own flowers for a vase, bouquet, arrangement or basket, or ask for a personalised arrangement for each occasion. The florists design for weddings, funerals and receptions, and the business also offers flower contracts. The business says it selects only the best flowers and aims for superior quality, attention to detail and freshness at low prices. Its florists are described as experts in floral design who want to create only the best arrangements. The website presents the market as a friendly place to find every floral need.

Cemcrete is a family-owned South African manufacturer of decorative cement coatings and specialised construction products, in business since 1973. Its range includes microcement, terrazzo overlays, decorative wall coatings, pool finishes, waterproofing systems and other cement-based solutions for interior and exterior surfaces. The company says its products are specified by architects, interior designers, contractors and homeowners across Southern Africa and internationally, for residential, commercial, retail and hospitality projects. Cemcrete has four showrooms and three warehouses in Johannesburg, Centurion and Cape Town. Its products are also stocked by third-party retailers across Southern Africa, Mauritius and further afield. The website shows featured projects and style guides.

Centigrade Refrigeration is a custom refrigeration business serving southern Africa, and it describes itself as a leader in coldroom solutions. It designs and builds cold rooms and freezer rooms, including custom-built walk-in chillers, preparation areas and residential cold-storage solutions. Its range also includes glass-door display systems for cold and freezer rooms, door solutions in swing, sliding, personnel and container styles, and modular buildings. Accessories include strip curtains, meat rails, S-hooks and shelving. Its smart monitoring service tracks coldroom temperature 24 hours a day and sends instant SMS alerts, which the company says help protect stock and reduce downtime. Each solution is designed around the customer's temperature, capacity and daily use.

Chandel Security offers security services to individuals and to businesses. For individuals it provides CCTV solutions, security manpower, alarm monitoring, risk assessments and investigations. For businesses it offers security audits, system analysis, threat analysis, and security for corporate events. The company describes its offering as complete security solutions and highlights its risk management services. Its team is made up of operational and technical specialists, and the company says its suppliers are kept up to date with global trends and market needs. The website highlights excellent follow-up, turnaround time and product knowledge, and says the company has offices and satellite branches in every service area.

Clampon (Pty) Ltd manufactures slurry pinch valves and HDPE and PVC couplings and fittings for the mining, waterworks and related industries. The company says it manufactures locally and works throughout Africa with mining corporations. Its valves include the open-frame slurry pinch valve and the Max-Flo enclosed pinch valve, which the company offers as direct replacements for diaphragm valves. Pressure ratings run from 1000 kPa to 4000 kPa, and sizes range from 50 mm to 500 mm, with larger sizes built to client specification. Refurbishment takes 7 to 10 working days and costs 50 to 60% of a new valve. Standard finish is QD enamel, with powder coating, electroplating and galvanising available on request.

CLS Human Capital Specialists is a Pretoria-based firm offering human resources and organisational development solutions, in business since 1996. The firm says it provides a full spectrum of HR solutions, focusing mainly on small and medium-sized enterprises. It partners with small and medium businesses and builds specialised services around each company's unique needs, including customised HR consulting. The firm believes human capital development is vital to the growth of all enterprises. Its stated values are professionalism, excellence, care for people, trustworthiness, ownership of work, teamwork and clear communication. The website invites businesses to get in touch to discuss how the firm's services can fit their people needs.

ColourCraft Print is a Pretoria printing company operating from 116 Lys Street in Rietondale, and it says it has been running since 2000. Its work falls into four areas. Lithographic printing is aimed at long runs and bulk jobs with consistent colour, covering business stationery and letterheads, quotation, delivery and invoice books, medical and clinical forms, diaries, desk pads, flyers and brochures. Digital printing suits shorter runs and quick-turnaround jobs, including short-run stationery, personalised documents, proofs and variable data printing. The branding range covers vehicle branding and wraps, gazebos and event structures, signage and safety signs, exhibition displays, banners and promotional merchandise. The company also produces cut-to-shape and roll stickers and labels, including product and packaging labels, safety labels, window and floor graphics.

Conscius is an independent corporation of electrical and electronic consulting engineers, with offices in Johannesburg, Pretoria and Mauritius. Its stated objective is to provide and integrate innovative, cost-effective electrical engineering services, with an emphasis on financial control and risk management. Its clients include government bodies, parastatal institutions, regional services councils, city councils and municipalities, as well as private developers, industrialists, corporate offices, major retail shopping centre projects and hospitals. Its services cover electrical infrastructure development, master plans, upgrading of existing electrical networks, macro and micro electrical infrastructure, and electrical and electronic services. Projects listed on the website include pressure reducing and pressure protection station control, and SCADA and control systems on a Sasol pipeline project in Polokwane, completed in 2015.

Constructo describes itself as a high-performance contractor and a future-facing mining services company focused on operational excellence. The company says it helps clients extract value safely and efficiently, and that it delivers on time, every time. It works in environments that include remote locations, community-sensitive areas, and high-risk, high-value projects. Constructo highlights sustainable mine rehabilitation among its services, and says the environment, health and safety of its employees are integral to all of its operations. The company says its people are resilient, highly skilled, disciplined and growth-focused, and that its consistent delivery mindset and internal culture set it apart from other service providers. It states an ambition to grow beyond its current capacity and to reach new clients.

Contact Labour (Pty) Ltd, which trades as Cont@ct Labour, is a labour law and HR services firm for South African businesses. Its labour law practitioners provide CCMA representation at the Commission for Conciliation, Mediation and Arbitration, and support employers through disciplinary hearings that aim to meet legal standards. Its labour relations support covers day-to-day employer-employee relations, with the aim of keeping operations running while minimising risk. The firm also offers wider HR solutions and guidance on the Labour Acts that govern employment. The website lists Employment Equity (EE) and skills services among its offerings. The practitioners work across South Africa and combine technical knowledge of employment legislation with practical business sense.

CSI Clutch & Brake (South Africa) (Pty) Ltd was founded on 18 October 1988 and supplies new, high-quality TRAX clutch and brake parts for trucks, buses, agricultural equipment, passenger cars, LDVs and 4x4 vehicles. It also supplies new and refurbished brake and clutch equipment. The company has a factory that refurbishes clutches for all makes of trucks, buses, tractors, cars, LDVs and 4x4s. Its clutch range includes clutch kits, driven and pressure plates, clutch bearings, slave cylinders and components such as facings, rivets and diaphragms. Its brake range includes heavy-duty brake linings, brake drums and discs, disc brake pads, bonded brake shoes, bonding adhesives and brake hoses. Equipment offered includes brake lining and clutch plate riveters, bonding ovens, lathes for brake drums and discs, and clutch test benches.

De Souza Hardware & Brick Depot in Hestea Park is a supplier of building materials in Pretoria. It stocks a wide range of bricks and blocks in many shapes, textures and sizes from well-known brands, along with paving bricks in different sizes, colours and textures. Its sand range includes plaster sand, building sand, topsoil, a sand and stone blend and play pen sand. Stone is available in 6mm, 13mm and 19mm sizes, along with crusher dust. For cement, the business stocks PPC Surebuild 32.5 and BB Cement 32.5. The business also carries other building products in store, and says it has over 12 staff members who strive for efficiency and quality. Its website describes the business as a name customers can trust.

items.reason: Thin: the one page (designacakesa.co.za) holds a short tagline, a flavour list and a cake-stand hire line, about 70 sourced words; no owned description of the business, team or history.

items.description: Dexitt Brand Design is a graphic design and branding studio based in Centurion, Pretoria, working with clients across Gauteng, South Africa and internationally. The studio says its work spans hospitality, law, engineering and finance. Its services include custom logo design, full brand identity systems, style guides, business cards and stationery. It also produces marketing and advertising material such as flyers, brochures, posters, digital adverts and email newsletter visuals. Social media design covers branded post templates, Instagram and Facebook content, highlight covers and story templates. Print design includes packaging, product labels and tags, booklets and catalogues. The studio says each project begins with listening, and that its design should clarify rather than complicate.

Dis-Chem Thatchfield Pharmacy is a branch of the Dis-Chem pharmacy and health retailer, at Thatchfield Retail Centre on Brakfontein Road in Thatchfield, Centurion. The store has a dispensary and offers click and collect. It also has an in-store clinic, a baby wellness clinic and a hair salon. Store hours are Monday to Friday 9am to 6:30pm, Saturday 9am to 5pm and Sunday 9am to 4pm. The clinic and baby wellness clinic open on weekdays from 9am to 5:30pm and are closed on Saturdays and Sundays, but open from 9am to 2pm on public holidays. The hair salon opens on weekdays from 8:30am and on Saturdays from 8am to 4pm.

DJM Tax & Business Solutions (Pty) Ltd is a business administration services firm in Irene, Pretoria, and its LinkedIn page lists seven employees. Beyond tax, it describes itself as a strategic extension of its clients' teams. Its services include registering new businesses with CIPC, SARS, the Department of Labour, the workmen's compensation fund and other official bodies. It mentors business owners on policies and procedures so their finances and administration stay under control, and can bring in specialist consultants for quality control. Payroll administration is offered on Sage Payroll Online, Simple Pay and Intercode Payroll, alongside HR control, bookkeeping and accounting. The firm is a partner for Sage Online Accounting, QuickBooks and Xero, offering implementation, training and support.

Earthcor is a manufacturer and supplier of earthing and lightning protection products, which the company describes as Southern Africa's largest manufacturer of copper, brass and alloy solutions. Its product range includes earth rods, conductors, clamps and connectors, exothermic welding under the Thermexweld name, couplings, driving caps and drill tips, and grounding tapes and putties. The company says its earthing and lightning protection products are Eskom approved. The website lists branches in Pretoria, Cape Town, Durban, Port Elizabeth and Wadeville. It also publishes quality standards, downloads, a mass calculation formula and copper flat bar conductor ratings for technical users. The site is published by Copalcor (Pty) Ltd.

Earthen Coffee Roasters is a South African coffee roaster, established in 2015, that sells fresh roasted coffee at retail and wholesale. Its range includes single origins, coffee blends and decaf, and it sells both whole beans and ground coffee. The roaster describes coffee as a fruit to be enjoyed fresh, and its website describes its coffee as a symphony of flavours from around the world. The website also offers brewing guidance, including a recipe for black coffee made in an AeroPress with a medium-fine grind and a steep time of at least eight minutes. In store, customers can ask for a specific grind size. The business ships internationally to Mauritius, the UAE and the UK.

East Side Doors and Security is a garage door and security business serving Pretoria East, Centurion and other parts of Gauteng. It installs, repairs and maintains garage doors, and offers emergency garage door repairs around the clock. The company installs doors from manufacturers including Centurion, Gemini and Digidoor, in traditional, carriage house and contemporary designer styles. Its other services include automatic gates and fences for security and privacy, CCTV camera installation for homes and businesses, controlled access to property, and irrigation installations. The website also promotes garage door operators for residential roll-up doors, which the company says offer reliable operation through door load profiling.

Ecotech Audio Visual is a Pretoria company that designs, installs and commissions audio-visual and video production systems. The business says it fills the gap between imported equipment and commissioned systems, delivering turnkey solutions for the audio-visual market. Its work includes data projectors for boardrooms and plasma and LCD screen equipment. Its listing describes audio-visual equipment sales and hire, as well as video production. The website gives its address as 3 Kameeldrift, Roodeplaat, Pretoria. A separate ECOTECH Furniture range covers office furniture and executive design furniture. The company describes itself as the connection, using the Zulu word Hlanganisa. The Cylex listing tags the business under computer stores and computer repairs, and shows it open Monday to Friday, with weekday hours of 8am to 5pm (Monday from 8:15am) and closed at weekends.
